messages.text: hey yes i want to buy one :) how can i order it?
Happy to help. Which one are you after? If you tell me the miner and where it's shipping, I'll pull live price and stock and build the cart for you.
BS-4 and i am living in austria
Read the bitfortun bs 4 page

The B.4 isn't buyable yet, the drop moved to mid-October and there's no exact date set. Price is $599.99, and a drop sells to whoever checks out first, so I can't hold one. Give me your email and I'll make sure you hear the moment the date lands.

For A., note the price excludes 21% import VAT, which customs charges on delivery.

If you don't want to wait, the Magic Miner 40T is $799 for 40 TH/s and ships November 14. Want me to price that one?
can you calculate me the full price when ill order the BS-4 to austria when it drops?

Roughly, the unit is $599.99. Austrian customs charges 21% import VAT on delivery, so about $126 on top, call it $726 landed before shipping. Any duty on top of that is set by customs, not us, so I can't quote it exactly.

Shipping is separate and calculated from your address at checkout, so you'd add that too. I can't get a shipping figure until the product is buyable again.

Want me to note your email for the drop date?

yes please add my email: (email hidden)
do i get an email exactly when it drops or few days before?
Handed to the team · BS-4 not purchasable, drop date mid-October not set; customer asked to be told w

Got it, (email hidden) is on the list for the BS-4.

You'll hear as soon as the date is set, which should be ahead of the drop, not on the day itself. That gives you time to be ready, since units go to whoever checks out first and we can't reserve one.

The team has been pinged to confirm it's noted. Stay in the chat if you can, otherwise it comes to your email.

i am not always looking on this chat so please also notice me on my email.

why is the drop delaid?

Your email's on it, so the notice goes there, nothing needed from you here.

The delay is firmware. After the issue with Bitfortun's BS-1 and BS-2, where the hashrate the unit displayed didn't match what it actually delivered, they're correcting that on the BS-4 before it ships. We'd rather launch it a bit later than sell you a number the machine can't hit.

That's also why there's no firm date yet, just mid-October.
but the BS-4 will hit the 22TH/s for sure?

The listed spec is 22 TH/s from 4x BM1373 at around 300W, and the reason for the delay is exactly that: they're making sure the number on the screen is the number the machine delivers at the pool.

I won't promise you a figure before the firmware is signed off. If it lands different, the listing gets corrected before it goes on sale, and you'd see that before you pay.

Anything else you want checked on it?
perfect, thank u for this informations!
Used the chat-interview skill
Before you go, one thing: what made you settle on the BS-4 rather than one of the other miners?
price, hashrate, efficiency and watercooling ;)
Water cooling stands out there. Is that about noise where it'll sit, or heat, or something else?
my first miner with watercooling so lets see
Fair enough. Last one: you pushed on whether it really hits 22 TH/s. Had you already heard about the hashrate trouble on the earlier Bitfortun units, or was that just caution?
yes i have heard about it, that they were off about 400GH/s, but for me that wouldnt be a problem if this makes 22TH/s - 400GH/s

Understood, and that's a fair way to look at it. Thanks for telling me, that's genuinely useful.

You're set: the drop notice goes to (email hidden) as soon as the date is fixed, and a copy of this chat comes to your email once we're done here. Enjoy the water cooling when it lands.
